def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    r=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if 3 in row)
    c=grid[r].index(3)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for j in range(w): out[r][j]=3
    for i in range(h): out[i][c]=3
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
        if i==r or j==c: continue
        # Each region carries alternating stripes away from its nearest divider.
        if i>r: out[i][j]=4 if j%2==0 else 0
        elif j>c: out[i][j]=4 if j%2==1 else 0
        else:
          # Sierpinski-like bit pattern in upper-left quadrant, represented by parity of
          # the 2-adic valuation of the row/column coordinate.
          # Use observed alternating column bands; rows toggle the bands recursively.
          a,b=i,j
          v=lambda x: (x & -x).bit_length()-1 if x else 99
          out[i][j]=4 if (v(a+1) >= v(b+1)) else 0
    return out
PY
